name: Stormbringer: Pulse Conversion heals 3% of maximum health on a Stormbreaker dispel (#3141)
contract: #3141: Pulse Conversion (707619) reads "Dispelling a magic effect with Stormbreaker now heals you for $504830s1% of your maximum health." Nothing delivered it. Its only effect is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (42) triggering 504830, but its ProcFlags are 0, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs never builds a proc entry for it (src/server/game/Spells/SpellMgr.cpp:2257-2258 'if (!spellInfo->ProcFlags) continue;'), no spell_proc row exists, and 3.3.5a has no proc flag for a successful dispel at all - the aura can never fire. The trigger spell would also not honour the tooltip: 504830 'Heal 3% Max' is Effect[0] = 10 SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL with EffectBasePoints[0] = 2 + EffectDieSides[0] = 1, i.e. three raw hit points, not three percent (contrast the Wildwalker analogue 525015, which uses 136 SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL_PCT). The fix consumes the core's own OnSpellSuccessfulDispel hook (src/server/game/Spells/SpellEffects.cpp:3009), mirroring modules/mod-ascension-compat/src/AscensionPrimalistEmeraldWill.cpp, and casts 504830 on the caster with base point 0 set to CountPctFromMaxHealth(3), the 3 being read from 504830's own effect value rather than hardcoded. Deliberate decision: one heal per successful Stormbreaker dispel event, not one per removed effect - the in-repo precedent for this hook (Emerald Will) ignores the hook's count, and this scenario removes exactly one aura so both readings agree here. Spell power cannot inflate the heal: 504830 has DmgClass 0 SPELL_DAMAGE_CLASS_NONE, EffectBonusMultiplier[0] = 0 and no spell_bonus_data row, so Unit::SpellHealingBonusDone returns the amount unchanged (src/server/game/Entities/Unit/Unit.cpp:10178-10183). Stormbreaker (705669) itself is native: SPELL_EFFECT_DISPEL, EffectMiscValue 1 DISPEL_MAGIC, TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ENEMY, and Arcane Intellect 1459 (Dispel = 1, beneficial) on a hostile player is dispellable with a 100% chance because neither side carries SPELL_AURA_MOD_DISPEL_RESIST. The maximum health of the caster is fixtured to 10000, so the promised heal is exactly 10000 * 3 / 100 = 300; the effective-heal assertion uses a minimum because a healing critical only raises it. Before the fix the heal log for 504830 stays empty, which is what the two DISCRIMINATING assertions read.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the hostile player carries the beneficial magic aura to dispel
SETUP: the caster's maximum health is fixtured to 10000, so 3% is 300
BASELINE: Stormbreaker's native dispel removes the beneficial magic aura
BASELINE: without Pulse Conversion the dispel heals nothing
SETUP: learning Pulse Conversion applies its passive aura on the caster
SETUP: the hostile player carries the beneficial magic aura again
SETUP: the caster is at 1 health, so a 300 heal cannot become overhealing
SETUP: the second Stormbreaker dispel succeeds as well
DISCRIMINATING: the successful dispel triggers exactly one Pulse Conversion heal
DISCRIMINATING: that heal is 3% of the 10000 maximum health, i.e. at least 300, not the 3 raw points of the record
